uslaw-usc-t36-s110308.title: 36 U.S.C. § 110308 — Service of process
uslaw-usc-t36-s110308.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s110308.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1103 (Jewish War Veterans, U.S.A., National Memorial, Incorporated). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The corporation shall have a designated agent in its headquarters in the District of Columbia to receive service of process for the corporation. Notice to or service on the agent, or mailed to.
